sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the three levels of arousal from above based on Likkutei Torah: arousal from above in itself, arousal drawn through arousal from below, and arousal as a gift that comes only after the completion of service.

translations.translation: And the explanation of the greatness of the elevation of “you will be remembered”
(which is drawn through “your place will be remembered”)
in more detail,
will be understood according to what is explained in Likkutei Torah11
that in arousal from above there are three levels.
Arousal from above that is from itself,
arousal from above that is aroused and drawn through arousal from below
(the service of man),
and arousal from above that comes as a gift from above, but its drawing is specifically after the completion of service.
And it is explained there,
that the arousal from above that is from itself is from a place that arousal from below does not reach there
[namely,
that the drawing of this arousal from above is from the Ein Sof that is above worlds,
in relation to which,
arousal from below is considered as nothing12],
and the arousal from above that is drawn through arousal from below is from a place that arousal from below reaches there
[namely,
that in this place there is value to the creations,
to the extent that their service
(arousal from below)
arouses and draws arousal from above],
and the arousal from above that is in the manner of a gift,
its drawing is from a place that arousal from below does not reach there,
except that it does not dwell and become revealed except after the completion of service
[and the arousal from above that is drawn through it].
For although this arousal from above comes as a gift from above,
nevertheless, there must be some vessel for this,
for the Holy One, blessed be He, does not dwell except in a complete place13,
and therefore14,
in order for there to be the revelation of this arousal from above
(which comes in the manner of a gift)
there must be the completeness of the actions of the lower ones
[arousal from below and the arousal from above that is aroused and drawn through it].

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the revelation of “you will be remembered” is even higher than the arousal from above after the completion of service, because it is in the level of Ein Sof where all is considered as nothing.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that the revelation of “you will be remembered” is more elevated
(also)
than the arousal from above after the completion of service15.
For that the completion of man’s service
(the actions of the lower ones)
is like a vessel for the revelation of the arousal from above,
indicates that man’s service has some value and connection to the arousal from above.
For in the Ein Sof that is above connection to worlds, where everything before Him is considered as nothing,
it is not applicable to say that the completion of the actions of the lower ones is a fit place
(a complete place)
for the revelation of the Ein Sof,
for since everything before Him is considered as nothing,
behold, in relation to this revelation,
this is not a complete place.
And the matter of remembrance
(and you will be remembered)
is in the level of Ein Sof where everything before Him is considered as nothing,
similar to the matter of remembrance which applies only to something that is not considered in his eyes
(as above).

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section questions how man’s self-nullification can arouse the level of Ein Sof where all is nothing, and explains that “you will be remembered” is aroused specifically through man’s service of self-nullification.

translations.translation: And it must be understood,
that in the level of Ein Sof where everything before Him is considered as nothing,
even man’s self-nullification is seemingly considered as nothing,
and how is it possible that man’s self-nullification
(“your place will be remembered”)
should arouse, as it were, in this level that there should be “you will be remembered.”
And to add,
that the arousal from above that is drawn after the completion of service,
although in relation to this level there is some value to man’s service
(as above in section 2),
nevertheless, it is not drawn through man’s service but from the side of above
(from the side of His kindness,
for He desires kindness16),
and that it is not drawn and revealed to man except after the completion of service is in order that man should be fit to receive the revelation
(but not that the service draws the revelation,
and certainly not that it arouses it),
and the matter of “you will be remembered,”
which is in the level of Ein Sof where everything before Him is considered as nothing,
is aroused, as it were, through man’s service
(self-nullification),
that through “your place will be remembered”
(of man)
it is brought about that there should be “you will be remembered.”
